title: Python/Node coordination conformance
root_cause: Python and Node independently encode authoritative coordination invariants with divergent validity and violation IDs.
source_requirement: Drive both implementations from one shared conformance corpus and stable semantic contract.
implementation_steps: Freeze stable violation IDs and evaluation order.
Make Python and Node consume equivalent rules.
affected_tests: Coordination state and extension dashboard tests.
evidence_required: One vector corpus and byte-comparable Python/Node result receipt.
rollback: Restore both validators together; never leave one runtime authoritative alone.
acceptance_criteria: Python and Node return identical validity and stable violation IDs for every authoritative vector.
